analysis.evidence: וַיְהִי introduces the narrative. The following phrase בִּימֵי, “in the days of,” dates the event by naming the four kings.
analysis.morphology: The prefixed conjunction וַ marks יְהִי, the short third-person masculine singular Qal form of הָיָה, as a wayyiqtol. The verb is used impersonally.

analysis.evidence: אַמְרָפֶל מֶלֶךְ שִׁנְעָר identifies Amraphel as king of Shinar. בִּימֵי dates the narrative to the time of his reign.
analysis.morphology: The prefixed preposition בִּ means “in” or “during.” ימֵי is the masculine plural construct of יוֹם, with אַמְרָפֶל as its complement.
analysis.sense: (pl.) days of a life, a reign or an age
